description: This file defines the 'SeoRegex' controller class for the OpenCart admin panel, handling CRUD operations and rendering views for SEO regex patterns.

classes.name: SeoRegex
classes.description: Controller class for managing SEO regex patterns in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main SEO regex management page with breadcrumbs and view components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of SEO regex patterns.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the list of SEO regex patterns with pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a SEO regex pattern.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing SEO regex pattern via AJAX.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected SEO regex patterns via AJAX.
